                s[i] = x;
            }
        }
        if (s[0] == '0') {
            return 0;
        }
        int ans = 1;
        boolean first = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {

                ans *= i == 0 ? 9 : 10;
                first = false;
            }
        }
        return ans;
